snippet.title: SYNCED | Season 1: Lambent Dawn Trailer
snippet.description:
SYNCED Season 1: Lambent Dawn sees the Meridian enveloped in an unknown aurora. This season, Runners will venture into the Meridian and hunt for the source of the mysterious aurora. This light has inspired a range of new environments, game modes, boss Nanos, and Guntech weapons. On top of that, an all-new Runner - Amelia - has crashed the party at Haven. Discover her backstory and how it relates to the aurora when Season 1: Lambent Dawn releases on December 14, 2023 on Steam and the Epic Games Store.
